title: WPSB/203/2025 of MOHAMMAD SUHAIL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
2025:UHC:4799-DB
1
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
THE HON'BLE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. G. NARENDAR
AND
THE HON'BLE JUSTICE MR. ALOK MAHRA
Writ Petition (S/B) No.203 of 2025
11th June, 2025
Mohammad Suhail -- Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others --Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Ms. Aananya Jain, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. J. S. Bisht, learned Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for respondent no.2.
Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
JUDGMENT : (per Mr. G. Narendar, C. J.)
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner,
learned State Counsel and learned counsel for respondent
nos. 2 & 3.
2. The petitioner has prayed for the following
relief:-
"a. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus directing Respondent No. 2 to extend
the final date to fill the online form for the
Uttarakhand Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior
Division) Exam-2023 advertised via Advertisement

2025:UHC:4799-DB
2
Number:- 04/E-2/DR/Civil Judge/2024-25 from the
5th of June, 2025 to such an appropriate date that
is just, fair, reasonable to all law students
graduating in 2025 so as to enable them to appear
for the said examination before the 3 years'
practice at the Bar rule comes into effect."
3. From a reading of the above relief sought for, it
is apparent that the petitioner has missed the bus and
has not filled the application form before the last date
stipulated. The reason being that the petitioner was not
eligible as on the specified date.
4. In that view of the matter, the relief sought for
cannot be granted. Accordingly, petition stands rejected.
5. The rejection of the petition would not come in
the way of the petitioner participating in future processes
that may be notified by the competent authority.
 (G. NARENDAR, C. J.)
